request.style: English, Children, solo female voice with gentle choir, acoustic guitar, piano, harp, soft percussion, warm and narrative, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the thirty-first year of Asa's reign
Omri took his seat upon the throne
He ruled for twelve years in the land
Six of them in Tirzah he held the land

[Pre-Chorus]
He saw a hill that needed a name
And he saw a price that would be paid
Two talents of silver he gave
To the owner of the hill in the valley

[Chorus]
He bought the hill of Samaria
From Shemer the owner of the land
He built a city on the stone
And named it after the man he found

[Verse]
But Omri did evil in the Lord's sight
More wicked than all who went before
He followed the path of Jeroboam
And led Israel away from the door

[Pre-Chorus]
With worthless idols they provoked
The God of Israel to be angry
They followed the sin of the king
And turned their hearts to vanity

[Chorus]
He bought the hill of Samaria
From Shemer the owner of the land
He built a city on the stone
And named it after the man he found

[Bridge]
The book of the kings records his acts
The exploits he performed are known
But Omri rested with his fathers
And was buried in the city alone

[Outro]
His son Ahab became king in his place
And the story of Israel continued on
